mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oval represents the top circular rim of the cylinder projected into the drawing. Right image: The oval is the plotted ellipse with horizontal semiaxis 5 and vertical semiaxis 3.
Rationales: The feature shows a circular rim of a solid in perspective in the left image and traces a plane ellipse on the axes in the right image. The closed outline of the visible cylinder top. The closed curve through A1, A2, B1 and B2.
